tagline_en: Even if memory and world are illusory, lived experience remains the irreducible real. In a mortal life, only revolt, immortal revolt......
tagline_zh: 即使记忆与世界皆可为虚幻，我仍以亲历的感受为不可名状的真实。有限的生命里唯有抗争、抗争....
intro_en: I write music for film and game, make electronic and computer music, pop songs, and build my own instruments from sensors and microcontrollers.
intro_zh: 我为电影和游戏创作配乐，制作电子与计算机音乐、流行歌曲，也用传感器和微控制器搭建自己的乐器。
about_en: Hi! I am Tianqi Zhang, a Chinese composer and electronic musician currently based in Bloomington. I am pursuing a double major in Screen Scoring and Computer Music at Indiana University. In an ever-changing world, I believe our own experiences are what stay with us. This is why I focus on interactive music. Through real-time sound and visuals, I hope to create experiences that form lasting memories and make each moment more meaningful.My music focuses on timbre, texture, and transformation, combining detailed electronic sound design with gestural interaction, emergent processes, and speculative storytelling. Through shifting layers of resonance, noise, spectral movement, and transient detail, I create immersive sonic worlds that move fluidly between order and instability, intimacy and vastness.
about_zh: 哈喽哈喽大家好，我叫张天琪，是个作曲家和电子音乐人，也写一些流行歌。我出生于河北保定，目前在印第安纳大学攻读影视配乐与计算机音乐双专业。在这个风云变幻的时代，唯有自身感受真实长存。所以我的作品更多为交互，我相信真实的视听结合体验更能带来深刻的记忆，感受到的实时变换让生命更有意义。我的音乐以音色、织体与声音形态的转化为核心，将细致的电子声音设计与手势交互、涌现过程和推想性叙事相结合。通过不断变化的共振、噪声、频谱运动与瞬态细节构建出游走于秩序与不稳定、亲密与浩瀚之间的沉浸式声音世界。
